question: Ustad Asad Ali Khan was a Rudra Veena player with expertise in _____ school of Drupad.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khandar**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Asad Ali Khan** was a Rudra Veena player with expertise in **Khandar school of Drupad.**
 
• **Hindustani classical music** from the Indian subcontinent includes the genre of **dhrupad**.
 
• It is the earliest known form of the main vocal genres connected to **Haveli Sangeet of Pushtimarg Sampraday**, Hindustani classical music, and the South Indian Carnatic tradition.
 
• **Sthayi (or Asthayi), Antara, Sanchari, and Abhoga are the four stanzas that make up a Dhrupad.**
 
• The history of Dhrupad may be traced back to Braj (Mathura) saints like as **Swami Haridas, Surdas, Govind Swami, Asht Sakha of Haveli Sangeet, Tansen, and Baiju Bawara.**
 
• **Vishnupad** is the term used when a **Dhrupad** composition is based on **Bhagwan Shri Vishnu** or one of his incarnations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ustad Asad Ali Khan**__

 
 
• Indian classical sarod player **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan** is renowned for his crisp and quick ekhara taans.
 
• Khan was born into a family of classical musicians and has been active on the international stage since the 1960s.
 
• In 2001, he received the **Padma Vibhushan**, the second-highest civilian decoration in India. At the University of New Mexico, Khan served as a visiting professor while performing with the **Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra**.
 
• He contributed a song to **Carrie Newcomer's** album Everything is Everywhere in 2011.
 
• One of the greatest classical instrumentalists of his day was **Ustad Haafiz Ali Khan Saheb of Gwalior, the father and Guru of Ustad Amjad Ali Khan.**
